##### Project general facts

Creek Haven by Emaar presents a beautifully crafted waterfront sanctuary where modern elegance meets serene living, offering an inspiring selection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments that radiate warmth and refinement. Every home is designed as a private retreat, enriched with soothing water views and soft natural light that elevates daily living. The project embodies Emaar’s signature quality, blending contemporary style with a calm, inviting atmosphere that feels both luxurious and effortless.

Within this exceptional development, residents are welcomed into spaces defined by clean lines, subtle contrasts and a harmonious palette that enhances both comfort and visual appeal. The apartments maximise openness, offering generous layouts that seamlessly capture the tranquil charm of Dubai Creek Harbour. Thoughtfully planned, each residence provides a peaceful and elegant environment crafted to enrich every moment.

Creek Haven elevates lifestyle with a curated collection of resort-style amenities designed for relaxation, wellness and recreation. Residents can enjoy an adult pool, kids pool, indoor and outdoor fitness areas, a padel court, yoga and relaxation zones, play areas and beautifully landscaped gardens. Every space has been shaped to inspire outdoor living, creating a community that feels vibrant, active and connected to nature.

Inside the homes, the interiors are offered unfurnished, allowing residents the freedom to personalise their spaces while enjoying Emaar’s refined standards in materials and craftsmanship. High-quality finishes, soft tones and well-designed kitchens create a clean, modern canvas ready for individual expression. The result is a sophisticated home environment that balances elegance, comfort and functionality in perfect harmony.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Creek Harbour - heart of bold new vision for Dubai. The eight square kilometre waterfront destination is bound to push the frontiers of architecture, design and the quality of life. Creek Beach is Dubai’s first-of-its-kind urban beach in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour. Located along the historic Dubai Creek.

Creek Beach is conceived to offered you the ultimate family-friendly retreat. From 700 metres of pristine white sands to the infinity pool and spectacular sunset views, this is paradise reborn. The centerpiece of Dubai Creek Harbour is the breathtaking Dubai Creek Tower, set to surpass the Burj Khalifa as the tallest structure globally. This architectural marvel is designed by the renowned architect Santiago Calatrava and will serve as a symbol of Dubai's ambition and innovation.

Dubai Creek Harbour represents a bold vision for the future of Dubai, blending cutting-edge design, sustainability, and cultural richness to create a dynamic and iconic waterfront destination. It not only serves as a testament to Dubai's commitment to innovation but also as a symbol of its ambition to create world-class living spaces.
